description: Recall of documented breaking/behavioural public-API changes and precision of reported changes, for since-cutoff 0.4.1, since-cutoff C2 (3f0144f), griffe check and AexPy on the benchmark's 7 library version pairs. Offline; ground truth from official changelogs/release notes/migration guides, verified against the wheels; matching and precision AI-judged (Claude Opus 5.5), no human.

tools.scc2: since-cutoff C2 as deployed (30-day cutoff margin: compares from an earlier release)

inaccurate_examples: mcp.types.Request[Union[RequestParams, NoneType], Literal['roots/list']] (RemoveClass): a parametrised pydantic generic (Request[..., Literal['roots/list']]) is an AexPy-internal entity, not an importable name
mcp.client.session.ElicitationFnT.__call__ (ChangeReturnType): return types named mcp.types.ElicitResult and mcp_types._types.ElicitResult are the same object (mcp.types mirrors mcp_types)
mcp.shared.session.BaseSession.send_request (ChangeParameterType): mcp.shared.session is gone in 2.2.0 (the whole module); a 'parameter type changed' report misstates it

items.description: Header names are now merged case-insensitively, so a differently cased custom header replaces the SDK's one.
Bedrock clients now raise ValueError when no AWS region can be found instead of defaulting to us-east-1.
The per-request params of messages.batches.create (MessageCreateParams) lost the temperature/top_p/top_k keys.
On the async client, raw responses from with_raw_response now need awaiting to parse/read (coroutines instead of sync methods).
The raw response's text is now a method instead of a property.
Skill-version VersionCreateResponse was replaced by BetaSkillVersion.
beta.messages.stream no longer takes temperature, top_p and top_k.
Top-level Transport alias of an httpx type was removed.
bytes header values now raise an error instead of being sent.
beta.files.list dropped before_id/after_id (now page=/ids=) and returns a cursor page.
messages.count_tokens's output_format now only accepts a type, not a schema dict.
The beta batch per-request params (beta MessageCreateParams) lost the output_format key.
isinstance(message_stream, Stream) no longer passes; the compatibility shim was removed.
The CompletionCreateParams request type was removed.
The HUMAN_PROMPT constant was removed.
The legacy Text Completions resource (client.completions) was removed.
SkillCreateResponse was replaced by BetaSkill.

griffe.adjudication: griffe reports the defining module anthropic.types.beta.skill_create_response removed (<module>), which contains the class

items.description: beta.skills.delete now deletes a skill with all its versions and returns a BetaDeletedSkill.
The raw response's content property is gone; the bytes are read with read().
Skill-version VersionListResponse was replaced by BetaSkillVersion.
Skill-version VersionRetrieveResponse was replaced by BetaSkillVersion.
The Completion response type was removed.
Low-level client.get/post/put/patch/delete no longer accept raw bytes as body= (now JSON-serialised; use content=).
beta.user_profiles.create dropped the relationship parameter (access_type replaces it).
The container skill reference type BetaSkill was renamed BetaContainerSkill (the old name now means the Skill object).

aexpy.adjudication: matched report is the removal of an incidental import alias of BetaSkill in anthropic.types.beta.beta_container, not the element

items.description: agent_toolset.READ_MAX_BYTES was removed; DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES is the name to use.
messages.stream no longer takes temperature, top_p and top_k.
SkillListResponse was replaced by BetaSkill.
GA request type for the mid-conversation system content block was removed.
SkillRetrieveResponse was replaced by BetaSkill.
The Responses function-call-arguments done event had its fields corrected (name field dropped).
HTTPX2 replaced httpx as the SDK's HTTP library; httpx is no longer installed and custom clients/transports/timeouts must be httpx2 objects.
Transport errors raised while iterating a stream are now normalised to SDK exceptions (APITimeoutError / APIConnectionError).
The default HTTP client now verifies TLS against the operating-system trust store instead of the certifi bundle.
repo_type_and_id_from_hf_id was removed; parse_hf_uri replaces it.
delete_space_storage was removed; Space volumes APIs replace it.
load_state_dict_from_file now loads safely by default (safe=True) and its pickle path defaults to weights_only=True.
Six inference providers were dropped from the accepted provider values of InferenceClient.
upload_large_folder (function and HfApi method) was removed; use upload_folder.
The PROTECTED member of InferenceEndpointType was removed; type='protected' now raises ValueError.
create_repo lost its space_storage parameter; use space_volumes.
filter_repo_objects allow/ignore pattern matching became case-sensitive on all platforms (changes Windows behaviour).
duplicate_repo lost its space_storage parameter; use space_volumes.
snapshot_download raises IncompleteSnapshotError instead of returning a partial cached folder when the Hub is unreachable and files are missing.
list_models lost its model_name parameter; use search.
request_space_storage was removed; Space volumes APIs replace it.
The constant INFERENCE_ENDPOINT_IMAGE_KEYS was deleted from huggingface_hub.constants.
create_inference_endpoint keeps the account_id keyword but ignores it (FutureWarning); PrivateLink settings moved to new parameters.
text_generation lost its stop_sequences parameter; use stop.
The HTTP dependency moved from httpx/httpcore to httpx2/httpcore2: client factories, sessions and transport exceptions now use httpx2 types.
InferenceClient no longer accepts a boolean token (token=True was a deprecated way to use the saved token).
duplicate_space was removed in favour of duplicate_repo.
FastMCP.call_tool() returns a CallToolResult instead of a content sequence / (content, structured) tuple.
mcp.shared.progress.ProgressContext removed with its module.
terminate_windows_process_tree() no longer accepts timeout_seconds.
Experimental tasks module mcp.server.experimental removed.
The SDK replaced httpx/httpx-sse with httpx2: transports take httpx2 clients/auth, raise httpx2 exceptions, and the OAuth providers subclass httpx2.Auth.
CreateMessageResultWithTools: camelCase fields (stopReason) are now snake_case attributes.

griffe.adjudication: griffe says class CreateMessageResultWithTools was removed; mcp.types still exports it via `from mcp_types import *` (griffe does not follow the wildcard mirror); only its camelCase fields changed

items.description: ServerSession.elicit_form() parameter requestedSchema renamed to requested_schema.
streamable_http_client yields a 2-tuple; the get_session_id callback is gone.
StreamableHttpParameters.timeout/.sse_read_timeout takes float seconds instead of timedelta.
FastMCP Settings lost its transport fields and mount_path (assigning them raises ValueError).
validate_scope() is no longer a method of OAuthClientMetadata (only of OAuthClientInformationFull).
Reading an unknown resource returns error -32602 with the uri in data instead of code 0.
ElicitRequestFormParams: camelCase fields (requestedSchema) are now snake_case attributes.

griffe.adjudication: same wildcard-mirror false removal (ElicitRequestFormParams still exported)

items.description: The TASK_FORBIDDEN constant was removed from mcp.types; use the string literal.
websocket_server removed.
LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION changed value from 2025-11-25 to 2026-07-28 (not negotiable in the initialize handshake).
Experimental tasks module mcp.server.lowlevel.experimental removed.
ElicitRequestURLParams: camelCase fields (elicitationId) are now snake_case attributes.
GetTaskPayloadRequestParams: camelCase fields (taskId) are now snake_case attributes.
Lowlevel Server.list_tools() decorator removed; pass an on_* handler to the constructor.
ClientNotification is a plain union alias instead of a RootModel class: no .root, no model_validate, no wrapping constructor.

griffe.adjudication: same (ClientNotification is still exported, as a union alias)

items.description: OAuthTokenError is no longer importable from mcp.client.auth.extensions.client_credentials (import from mcp.client.auth).
PromptsCapability: camelCase fields (listChanged) are now snake_case attributes.
ClientSession.read_resource() accepts only str for uri (AnyUrl no longer accepted).
Unexpected handler exceptions are reported to the client only as a generic 'Error executing tool <name>' message.
AudioContent: camelCase fields (mimeType) are now snake_case attributes.
Context.elicit() validates the rendered schema (TypeError) and raises ValueError on mismatched accepted content.
stdio_client shutdown leaves a gracefully exited server's children alive on POSIX and reports failed writes as CONNECTION_CLOSED.
Tool.run() now requires a context argument.
MCP protocol models no longer keep unknown fields (extra='allow' became ignore); extras are dropped and do not round-trip.
SQLContext.execute(eager=True) now collects through the default (streaming) engine.
Expr.map_elements drops returns_scalar.
group_by_dynamic drops by (use group_by).
cat.get_categories is removed.
to_numpy drops use_pyarrow.
LazyFrame.map_batches drops no_optimizations.
Expr.where is removed in favour of filter.
DataFrame.glimpse drops return_as_string.
read/scan_ipc drop row_count_name and row_count_offset.
GroupBy.count is removed in favour of len.
assert_series_equal drops check_dtype.
LazyFrame.collect drops streaming.
Series.search_sorted no longer accepts a Python list.
from_dataframe no longer falls back to the interchange protocol; non-PyCapsule objects raise.
pl.groups is removed.
pl.corr drops the ddof parameter.
LazyFrame.sink_* drop retries.
pl.rolling_corr drops min_periods.
read_ipc drops the memory_map and rechunk parameters.
Series.cat.uses_lexical_ordering is removed.
read_csv now behaves like scan_csv: list schema_overrides must cover all columns and columns=[...] keeps requested order.
testing.parametric.series drops size.
explain drops tree_format.
DataFrame.pivot drops columns (use on).
read_ods headerless auto column names start at column_0.
Selector &, |, ^ with pl.col(...) is now an element-wise operator rather than a column set operation.
DataFrame.write_ipc drops future.
Expr.register_plugin is removed.
arr.to_struct no longer accepts a callable for fields.
from_dataframe drops the allow_copy parameter.
st.pyplot can no longer be called without a figure (no global-figure fallback); fig is required.

aexpy.adjudication: AexPy: RemoveParameterDefault on streamlit.delta_generator.PyplotMixin.pyplot(fig): fig became required

items.description: st.switch_page called inside a widget callback now navigates instead of being a warned no-op.
The long-deprecated st.cache decorator was removed.
The deprecated Snowpark connection class and the 'snowpark' connection type were removed.
A keyed st.data_editor with num_rows='fixed' now derives its widget identity from the key and data schema instead of the full data.
AppTest widget interactions (set_value and the helpers built on it) now raise on disabled widgets.
The deprecated st.bokeh_chart command was removed.
st.iframe no longer loads a local file when given a string path; only pathlib.Path loads files.
st.rerun called inside a widget callback now triggers a rerun instead of being a warned no-op.
The deprecated use_column_width parameter of st.image was removed in favour of width.

aexpy.adjudication: AexPy: 'Remove PositionalOrKeyword parameter (streamlit.delta_generator.ImageMixin.image): use_column_width' (path via the DeltaGenerator mixin, which the matcher's module rule rejected)

items.description: AppTest.query_params now holds single values as strings rather than one-item lists.
st.html no longer loads a local file when given a string path; only pathlib.Path loads files.
beta.connectors.list_organization_credentials auth_type type changed from OutboundAuthenticationType to AuthenticationType.
Connector became a union of HTTPConnector and MCPConnector discriminated on protocol; formerly flat fields moved to the variants.
DeploymentDetailResponse gained a required last_heartbeat field.
Connectors create_or_update_workspace_credentials was removed (replaced by create/update_credentials).
beta.connectors.list_workspace_credentials auth_type type changed from OutboundAuthenticationType to AuthenticationType.
EmbeddedResource lost additional_properties.
PromptsCapability lost additional_properties.
VoiceResponse gained a required type field.
Chat-completion-events operation fetch_similar_events was removed.
Observability campaigns operation list was removed with the campaigns resource.
Chat-completion-events operation search_ids was removed.
beta.connectors.list_user_credentials auth_type type changed from OutboundAuthenticationType to AuthenticationType.
UnknownAuthorization (open-union fallback of CustomConnector.authorization) was removed.
PromptArgument lost additional_properties.
Fields operation fetch_option_counts was removed.
AuthenticationConfiguration.authentication_type type changed from OutboundAuthenticationType to AuthenticationType.

aexpy.adjudication: matched report is the removal of an incidental import alias of AuthenticationConfiguration in the removed module mistralai.client.models.connector, not the documented field-type change

items.description: The workflows runs SDK class Runs was renamed WorkflowsRuns.
agents.stream no longer accepts the code_interpreter, web_search and web_search_premium tools.
chat.complete no longer accepts the code_interpreter, web_search and web_search_premium tools.
The dataset records SDK class Records was renamed DatasetsRecords.
chat.stream no longer accepts the code_interpreter, web_search and web_search_premium tools.
BlobResourceContents lost additional_properties.
AudioContent lost additional_properties.
Chat-completion-events operation judge was removed.
TasksElicitationCapability.create changed from Dict[str, Any] to TasksCreateElicitationCapability.
Datasets import_from_explorer was removed.
Observability campaigns operation create was removed with the campaigns resource.
Connectors create_or_update_organization_credentials was removed (replaced by create/update_credentials).
Or changed from a union alias of FilterGroup | FilterCondition (2.9.x) to an object model with type and matches.
agents.complete no longer accepts the code_interpreter, web_search and web_search_premium tools.

task_items.description: with_raw_response: .text property becomes a method on the new response class
beta Messages.create no longer takes output_format (use output_config)
httpx -> httpx2: custom http_client must be httpx2
async raw response parse() becomes a coroutine
httpx -> httpx2 default HTTP client (event hooks)
httpx -> httpx2: respx/httpx test doubles no longer intercept
transport errors while reading a stream now raise APIConnectionError/APITimeoutError
httpx -> httpx2 for client factory and errors
CallToolResult camelCase fields renamed to snake_case
host/port moved off the server constructor to run()
st.image use_column_width removed (kept as ignored keyword-only no-op)

scc2m0.adjudication: same report as st-004: ImageMixin.image use_column_width became keyword-only (the task item lists only streamlit.image)
